description: What submit will say right now: missing or invalid answers per step, document problems, warnings. ready_to_submit true means submit will go through (payment aside); a FILED_BY_SPECIALIST warning means it goes to a Visarun specialist who files it by hand, as the automation does not file these answers (the warning says why): tell the person. An issue's resolve_with lists the ticks the form offers to clear it (an acknowledgement such as 'I will arrange travel insurance separately', a Does Not Apply box) as answers for visarun_save_answers; empty when only an upload or a corrected answer clears it.
name: visarun_validate_application
title: Validate application
